description: This file defines data structures, constants, and function declarations for configuring audio policy engine settings in Android, including volume curves, product strategies, criteria, and parsing functions.

classes.name: AttributesGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of audio attributes associated with a specific stream and volume group.

classes.name: CurvePoint
classes.description: Represents a point on a volume curve with an index and attenuation value.

classes.name: VolumeCurve
classes.description: Defines a volume curve for a device category with multiple curve points.

classes.name: VolumeGroup
classes.description: Defines a volume group with a name, index range, and associated volume curves.

classes.name: ProductStrategy
classes.description: Represents a product strategy with a name and associated attribute groups.

classes.name: CriterionType
classes.description: Defines a criterion type with a name, inclusivity flag, and value pairs.

classes.name: Criterion
classes.description: Defines a criterion with a name, type, and default value.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Holds the entire configuration including version, strategies, criteria, and volume groups.

classes.name: ParsingResult
classes.description: Holds the result of parsing a configuration file, including the parsed config and skipped elements.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the specified audio policy configuration XML file and returns the configuration.

methods.name: parseLegacyVolumes
methods.description: Parses legacy volume configurations into volume groups.

methods.name: parseLegacyVolumeFile
methods.description: Parses a legacy volume configuration file into volume groups.
